about_the_game:
Take your ATC skills to a new level with Hamburg Airport (EDDH). Whether you’re handling the morning commuter crush, scheduling heavy wide-body arrivals, or juggling tight taxiway jams, this airport offers the perfect mix of realism, complexity and gameplay fun. Add this to your Tower Simulator arsenal and experience one of Germany’s key air hubs in full control.

Hamburg Airport (EDDH), one of Germany’s busiest aviation hubs! Located just north of the city center, Hamburg combines history, efficiency, and complexity to deliver an exciting air traffic control experience. With two intersecting runways, dual terminals, this add-on offers the perfect challenge for both new and veteran controllers.

Guide a mix of short-haul traffic and long-haul international flights through realistic ground and tower operations. Manage arrivals and departures on runways 05/23 and 15/33, coordinate crossing traffic, and keep a constant flow through Hamburg’s compact yet busy airfield. Every session brings new challenges. 

Built for Tower! Simulator 3, this detailed recreation includes an authentic airport layout, accurate frequencies, and support for customization* (*with MIYO). Whether you prefer calm regional ops or heavy international traffic, Hamburg Airport gives you total control over one of Germany’s most dynamic skies.
